individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the 141 points is an individual sample; marginal histograms show full distributions.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present; the red curves are fitted gamma distribution lines, not error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each point is a mean of 6 (or fewer) replicate samples per reporter with error bars, but the underlying individual replicate values are not shown.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean ± s.d. of 6 samples per reporter
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are defined in the caption as mean plus/minus s.d.

individual-data-points.explanation: These are density/line plots of fitted normal distributions, a plot type exempt from showing individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on these fitted distribution curves.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plot, a chart type that already conveys the data distribution and is exempt; individual points are additionally overlaid.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: with the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box edges, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histograms depict full probability distributions of phase differences rather than single averaged values, so individual point overlay is not applicable.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on these polar histograms.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histogram showing a distribution of phase differences averaged by subtype, a distribution-type plot exempt from individual point overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on this polar histogram.

individual-data-points.explanation: Line plot of a single example signal trace with fitted model, a plot type exempt from individual data point overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present; this is a single illustrative example trace.

individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the 117 points is an individual sample, with error bars reflecting fit parameter uncertainty for that sample.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are explicitly defined in the caption as the standard deviation of fitted parameters.
